parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, typically made of metal for durability and flexibility.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the frame and rests on the ear to hold the glasses in place.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge to fold or unfold the glasses.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of metal and designed symmetrically to the left leg.
parts.Functional_description: It provides balance and stability, resting on the opposite ear to secure the glasses.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge to fold or unfold the glasses.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the eyeglasses, including the frame and lenses, typically made of lightweight plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in position and provides the main structure for vision correction or protection.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central support for the legs and nose pads.
